notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
fixed that you could lose the key in portal 7 if you try to open an already opened door
 replaced wrong undestroyable chest in portal 7
 fixed looping Barghest death animation that made him die several times
 added text to explain the icons in upgrade windows

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.notes:
fixed that japanese hieroglyphs wasn't displayed during start cutscene 
 fixed that armor materials sometimes didn't properly displayed when updating

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Added spanish localization.
Special thanks to @Klumb3r

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
fixed holes on portal 1
  fixed items in the air in portal 6
  fixed that some items from portal 4 wasn't unloaded after returning to the Main Hall and could be seen and destroyed on other portals
  fixed visual noise in trees of the Dark Forest (portals 5-7) due to last LODs
  fixed enemy type for leech (didn't affect gameplay only visuals)
  added new challenges types (clear specific portal, destroy specific item and enemy)
  adjusted AI of Juggernauts (portals 14-15) and spiders
  now if you die when returned to the main hall your health will be half from maximum instead of full
  reduced build size on 300Mb

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
fixed that it was unable (until restart of the game) for clients to join a previous session if they just exit to menu and try to join 
  fixed that if you get an invite when the game wasn't launched you couldn't join. Now joining will be performed after the start cutscene
  fixed that clients could see damage on opened chests
  number of enemies in portal 2 were slightly increased
  two webs that were just decorations in portal 2 now can be destroyed
  fixed the landscape in portal 3 that was a little bit "alive" due to LODs

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
now hide HUD option is fires only to the gameplay and not all the hud
  fixed visual bug that next portal was not highlighted if you died on previous portal and then completed it
  fixed enemies sound sometimes didn't load from save
  fixed postprocess in treasure room in portal 15
  fixed that the chest after Spider boss could spawned in wrong place
  fixed the key in portal 7 that was half in the ground
  adjusted the amount of repeated tiles in portal 9
  rebalanced high-level portals enemies
  other minor improvements

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.notes:
fixed zero reward in challenges (you will have to refresh them)
  fixed torch in the air in portal 7
  fixed holes in portals 3, 17
  fixed client seen prisoners icons as it they were players
  rebalanced weapon cost

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback we've made bunch of improvement and fixed to the v1:


 fixed that some enemies didn't unload when returning to the Main Hall when you die
 fixed opened chests were showing the damage amount making you feel that you are able to destroy it
 fixed that it was possible to return to the Lobby without completing the dungeon
 fixed holes in the dungeon portal #20
 fixed missing sound of some enemies
 added volume for enemy sounds
 mouse sensitivity default value was decreased and now the default value is 40%
 challenges rewards are now calculated based on number of times you need to did the task
 upgrade terminals ui now contains information about level and experience points
